name: Clybourn Corrupters
description: Clybourn Corrupters were a Chicago street gang active in the 1960s and 1970s near the Cabrini Green area on the North Side of Chicago. They were rivals of the CORP, the Dayton and Armitage Latin Kings, the Young Lords, the Cobra Stones, the Disciples, the Black Deuces (Deuces Wild), and the Black Angels.
